title: Don't Escape Trilogy
summary: Collection of three point-and-click horror puzzle games built around preparation, problem solving and choices intended to avert dangerous outcomes rather than simply escaping a room.

observations.statement: The available review evidence strongly praises the trilogy's compact storytelling, pacing and progression across the three games.
The store presentation and review evidence describe a puzzle-focused point-and-click structure built around observation, preparation and consequence.
The Steam store lists English support and does not list official Russian localization.

steam_reviews.query: Steam Community review pages; Russian and non-Russian lanes attempted; accessible index was sparse
